message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on the described facts.

Facts: In 2012, defendant Guo instructed Shen to file a lawsuit with inflated loan amount, forging loan documents, causing the court to make an untrue mediation. This involves fraud (诈骗罪) by false claim to obtain money? Also possibly "伪造文书罪" (forgery of documents) because they falsified loan amounts and wrote false loan notes. Also "诬告陷害罪"? They caused false litigation. Could be "虚假诉讼罪" (false litigation) under criminal law: "伪证罪"? Actually false litigation is "虚假诉讼罪" (Article 313 of Criminal Law). Also "诈骗罪" if they obtained money by deception. The fact says they borrowed 71k, then inflated to 111k and sued to get money? Likely fraud. Also "伪造金融票证罪"? No, not financial tickets. It's forging loan documents, which is "伪造文书罪" (forgery of documents). So list: 诈骗罪; 伪造文书罪; 虚假诉讼罪. Need law names in Chinese. Use semicolons.

Thus answer: [罪名]诈骗罪;伪造文书罪;虚假诉讼罪<eoa>
